findings: src/execution/aggregate_hashtable.cpp:758: the change adds one condition, `layout_ptr->AllConstant()`, to the unpartitioned-staging branch in FindOrCreateGroupsInternal. When a layout has a heap (non-inlined strings, lists, structs with variable-size fields), new groups now go straight to partitioned_data, the same path already used when radix_bits is low or a chunk has many new groups. It is a property of the layout and has nothing to do with this query, its tables or its data.

Correctness: the partitioned path is the existing default and already handles everything downstream (reverse_partition_sel, row_locations, InitializeStates). unpartitioned_data is still created and repartitioned at lines 111-135 and counted at line 258; for heap layouts it simply stays empty, which those code paths already handle. NULLs, spilling and parallel execution behave the same as on the regular path.

Nothing touches measurement, settings or tests. The diff is one line and does what the issue describes. The only possible cost, scattered small appends for heap layouts, is a plain performance tradeoff that affects only aggregates whose group rows carry a heap.
